title: Expansion, Pullbacks & Progression
hook: Price pushes. Price pauses. Price pulls back. Then we see what it does next.

launchpad.outcome: Describe expansion, pullbacks and structural progression, and why a pullback alone isn’t a reversal.
launchpad.missionQuestion: When bullish structure starts pulling back, how do you know whether it has reversed?

steps.text: 1. Expansion: price makes meaningful directional progress. ↑ ↑ ↑
2. Pullback / retracement: price temporarily moves against the current move. ↑ ↑ ↓ A pullback does not automatically equal reversal.
3. Structural progression: after the pullback, price continues developing in a way that maintains or changes the larger pattern. Here: HH → pullback → HL → expansion → HH.

slides.body:
You’re going to notice throughout the Academy that price often moves in sequences rather than straight lines.

It moves. It corrects. It moves again.

Later, we’re going to give some of those behaviors much more specific meaning. 👀

slides.title: Has it reversed?
slides.scenario: Bullish structure. Price begins pulling back.

options.label: Yes
options.feedback: A pullback alone doesn’t tell us that.

options.label: No, it’s definitely continuing
options.feedback: We can’t know that yet either.

options.label: Not enough information
options.why: ✨ Exactly. The existence of a pullback does not tell us whether the larger structure has changed.

slides.title: What would we need to study?

check.prompt: If a pullback alone can’t tell us whether structure changed, what would we need to study next?

options.label: What price breaks
options.why: BOOM. 💥 That’s exactly where Section 2 begins: breaks, shifts and fakeouts.

options.label: How many red candles there are
options.feedback: Candle count and color don’t define structure.

options.label: How fast price is falling
options.feedback: Speed alone doesn’t tell you what changed structurally.

takeaways: Pullback: a temporary move against the current move, not automatically a reversal.
Progression: what price does after the pullback is what maintains or changes structure.
remember: A pullback alone doesn’t tell you whether structure changed. What price breaks does.
